text: 1.Photocopie du passeport valide With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Photo de passeport A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Diplôme de master Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Relevé de notes de l'école graduate 5.Certificat de HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6.Lettre de recommandation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Déclaration de votre plan de recherche Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.
